g.text: Objective: drop the company if any of the seven quality gates fails; every gate runs, so every failure is recorded.

text.tspan: no gate failed, so no quality rule is recorded as failed
the company is rejected, and every failed gate is recorded
every rule of the three layers runs
fails when the Damodaran industry is a financial services label (exact match)
or the industry contains bank or insurance (any case)
net debt ÷ earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) ≤ 4
net debt or EBITDA missing: fails (checked first)
EBITDA ≤ 0 with positive net debt: fails
earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) ÷ interest expense ≥ 2
interest expense missing: passes if total debt is missing or 0, else fails
operating cash flow > 0 in ≥ 4 of the last 5 years
the company with its failed quality gates (none or several), on to the value indicators whatever the result

g.text: a quality gate fails [a figure misses its threshold, or is missing]
on to the value indicators [always: every layer runs]
